test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

Modest stores and welcoming residents populated the __charming__ tiny town.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**charming**' means very pleasing or attractive.(आकर्षक).

 
 
• **Example **- Everyone I have met has been **charming **and attractive.
 
 
 
• '**Delightful**' means very pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable.(रमणीय,आनंदमय).
 
 
• **Example **- It's a **delightful **place to spend a holiday.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word of '**charming**' is '**delightful**'.

Therefore, **correct answer** is **Delightful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hind meaning and example sentences:

 
• **Hideous **(बहुत भद्दा,घृणित) - very ugly or unpleasant.

 
 
• **Example **- They've just built some **hideous **new apartment blocks on the waterfront.
 
 
 
• **Nasty **(बहुत खराब) - very bad or unpleasant.
 
 
• **Example **- She has a **nasty **habit of biting her fingernails.
 
 
 
• **Unpleasant **(अप्रिय,अरूचिकर) - causing you to have a bad feeling; not nice.
 
 
• **Example **- There was an **unpleasant **smell coming from the basement.
 
 

4e:Tb03,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
